follow-up time: From beginning of pregnancy until delivery
cohort: 322 pregnancies in 258 anti-SSA/Ro positive pregnant women
finding: Anti-SSA/Ro positive pregnant women with a defined systemic autoimmune disease undergoing strict follow-up from early pregnancy have a low risk of pregnancy complications, including CHB.
mod_finding: The authors note that there was no difference in mode of delivery between groups, except for cesarean section.
